claim_boundary: This contract fixes the states and mandatory evidence of a plugin on/off display (the 'plug') per consumer, host, plugin and scope. It is a schema-level artifact checked against synthetic fixtures. It performs no write, owns no writer and does not claim that any host, consumer or version currently supports activation. A missing source means unknown, never plugged and never unplugged.

observed_from: BACH plugin_sockets flag toggle (read-only analysis: no native write, no read-back, default plugged)
BACH plugin inventory (enabled_in_client per consumer, runtime_active null)
native Claude Code plugin enable/disable with list read-back (read-only analysis)

states.name: plugged
states.meaning: The native configuration says enabled, read back from the native source, and no restart is open.

states.name: unplugged
states.meaning: The native configuration says disabled, read back from the native source.

states.name: pending_restart
states.meaning: A change was written and read back, but its effect in the running consumer is not evidenced. runtime_active stays null.

states.name: unknown
states.meaning: No native source, not readable, or no entry. Also the only valid state when the source evidence is missing.

states.name: error
states.meaning: Writing or reading back failed, or the read-back contradicts the request. After a native write the way back is evidenced.

known_values.note: Documentation only, not a closed set: a new consumer needs no new contract version. Whether a consumer has a writer is a property of its evidence, not of this list.

error_codes.E_SCHEMA: The document schema is not the one of this contract or records is not a list.
error_codes.E_TYPE: A mandatory field has the wrong type (string, object, list, boolean).
error_codes.E_ENUM: A value is outside its enum or does not match its identifier pattern.
error_codes.E_KEY: A key field (consumer, host, plugin_id, scope) is missing, or the key appears twice.
error_codes.E_STATE: The state is not one of the contract states.
error_codes.E_MISSING_EVIDENCE: A mandatory evidence field of the state is missing or empty. The code carries the field name.
error_codes.E_TIME: A timestamp is not extended ISO-8601 with seconds and Z or numeric offset, or requested_at lies after observed_at.
error_codes.E_NO_READBACK: plugged or unplugged without readback_ref and config_revision. Without read-back nothing is plugged or unplugged.
error_codes.E_FLAG_ONLY: The source is a flag (for example the plugin_sockets table). A flag is no truth about the native configuration.
error_codes.E_DEFAULT_TRUE: plugged or unplugged is derived from absence or a default (source default or absence, or default_applied true). A missing source must yield unknown.
error_codes.E_FOREIGN_HOST_WRITE: writer_host differs from the host that owns the configuration. A foreign host is display only.
error_codes.E_MISMATCH_NO_ERROR: The requested value differs from the read-back value, or the read-back contradicts the state, but the state is not error.
error_codes.E_PENDING_RUNTIME: pending_restart with runtime_active other than null.
error_codes.E_RUNTIME_NO_REF: runtime_active is true or false without runtime_ref.
error_codes.E_NO_BACKUP: native_write is part of the steps but backup_ref is missing, or the backup step does not precede it.
error_codes.E_TOGGLE_ORDER: The toggle steps are not the ordered sequence plan, lock_host_check, backup, native_write, readback (complete for a non-error state, an ordered prefix for error).
error_codes.E_UNKNOWN_NEEDS_REASON: unknown without reason_code, or unknown carrying a read-back value.
error_codes.E_ERROR_NO_ROLLBACK: error after a native write without backup_ref, rollback_outcome (restored, not_needed, failed) and last_evidence.

rules.never_without_readback: plugged and unplugged need config_revision and readback_ref from the native source. Wish is not read-back.
rules.flag_only_is_no_truth: A flag or table of the display system (plugin_sockets) is never a source for plugged or unplugged.
rules.no_default_true: There is no default state. Missing source or missing entry is unknown. default_applied must be absent or false and cannot lead to plugged.
rules.writer_only_at_data_host: A write is only valid when writer_host equals the host of the record. Other hosts are display only.
rules.toggle_sequence: plan, lock_host_check, backup, native_write, readback, in this order. A backup_ref is mandatory once native_write appears.
rules.wish_is_not_readback: If requested_value differs from readback_value, or the read-back contradicts the state, the state must be error.
rules.pending_restart_without_runtime_proof: pending_restart keeps runtime_active null. Only runtime_ref evidence may make runtime_active true or false.
rules.error_evidences_the_way_back: error after a native write carries backup_ref, rollback_outcome and last_evidence.
rules.open_consumer: consumer is an identifier matching the consumer pattern. Known values are documentation, not a closed enum.
rules.key_unique: The key (consumer, host, plugin_id, scope) appears once per document.

next_gates: Adapter in the consuming system: endpoint, native writer, lock and backup (P3, owned by that system)
